faults.title: Coolant leak from thermostat housing (Mk3, 2011-2018)
faults.description: Carbuyer says the thermostat housing on the Mk3 can drip coolant, which it calls an easy fix. Coolant leaks were also covered by a recall, so check the recall work was done.

faults.title: Stop-start failing when the battery is low (Mk3)
faults.description: The stop-start system on the Mk3 can fail when the battery is weak. Carbuyer advises checking the engine stops and restarts smoothly at a standstill.

faults.title: Automatic gearbox, power steering and clutch problems (Mk3)
faults.description: Carbuyer names automatic gearbox issues, power steering failure and clutch problems on the Mk3, without detail. A broken clutch pressure plate was fixed under recall. Test each carefully.

faults.title: Several Mk3 recalls to confirm
faults.description: Carbuyer says the Mk3 was recalled quite often. If all recall work has been done the issues shouldn't be a worry, so ask for proof or check with a Ford dealer using the VIN.
